title.narrative: Procurement and installation of accounting software and financial management training for partners.

description.narrative: As a strategic direction, CAFOD is implementing development programmes through partners. These partners over the years lack the required capacity to provide CAFOD with accurate and timely financial reports, which however necessitate the need to improve and develop our local implementing partners. These organisations lack the right financial management software, which have a stronger impact on their mission and these organisations struggle to present standardized financial reports in terms of trying to meet donor’s demands. It is based on the afore-mentioned challenges and desire to capacitate these organisations that CAFOD has embark in supporting their partner organisations in Sierra Leone with basic accounting software and providing them with the required training, which is expected to bring about a turnaround in their financial reporting and hence increased their accountability and transparency to donors.
